{{Quote|Orycat<br />System: Orryxia. These small woodland creatures hunt in packs. Due to extraordinarily difficult conditions, I was unable to perform a complete survey of the rather foul creature's role in its local environment.|Personal notes of Wilek Nereus|<ref name="TTaBS" />}}
The '''Orryxia system''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system contained [[Forest/Legends|woodlands]] that were [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to [[orycat]]s, a [[Species/Legends|species]] of small pack [[Diet/Legends|predators]].<ref name="TTaBS" /> In addition, the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Feline/Legends|feline]] species known as [[Orryxian]]s<ref name="CSWE" /> hailed from the Orryxia system,<ref name="Planetnamia" /> and it was also the origin point of the [[Orryxian Catsblood]] beverage.<ref name="TTaBS" />

At some point before his [[Death/Legends|death]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Wilek Nereus]] of the<ref name="TTaBS" /> [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="EAOC Bakura">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Bakura system/Legends|Bakura system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] visited the Orryxia system, where he obtained several orycat [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] to add to his dental [[Collector/Legends|collection]]. The conditions of the orycats' native [[Tree/Legends|woodlands]], however, proved too challenging for Nereus to carry out a complete ecological survey of the creatures' habitat, a fact which the governor later documented in his personal notes.<ref name="TTaBS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Orryxia system was first mentioned in ''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]'', published in [[1996]] by [[West End Games]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TTaBS" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the system within grid square M-18.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
